title: [TOY FIXTURE, NOT A RESEARCH RESULT] Phase-bound running sum
summary: Test fixture only. A single complex accumulator where each token adds its value rotated by a fixed key phase. It shows the card shape and a runnable toy example. It makes no claim about sequence learning.

state.name: S
state.meaning: Running sum of all written values, each rotated by its key phase.

state.name: N_slots
state.meaning: Number of distinct key phases on the unit circle. Fixed by the design, not learned.

learning.description: No parameters are learned. The phase map theta is a fixed codebook.
learning.few_shot_argument: Toy only. A fixed codebook needs no training data to bind a key to a phase, so one write is enough for exact recall when a single pair is stored. The card makes no claim beyond that case.

complexity.constants_notes: One complex multiply-add per token for the write and one per query for the readout.

sample_efficiency.mechanism: The key codebook is fixed, so no examples are needed to learn the binding.

prediction.statement: With one stored pair, the readout at its key returns its value after one write.

capabilities.task: single key-value recall after one write
capabilities.prediction: Exact recall of the stored value at its own key. Accuracy >= 0.9 at m = 2.
Interference from other pairs is reported by the toy example and is not zero.

known_relatives.name: Fourier-feature linear attention
known_relatives.relation: A running sum of key-feature-weighted values with a fixed feature map.
known_relatives.claimed_difference: The state is a single complex scalar, not an outer-product matrix. This is a toy difference and is not a claim of novelty.

falsifiers: With one pair stored, the readout at its key differs from the stored value by more than 1e-9. The candidate beats the n-gram by less than 0.1 accuracy at m = 1.
With three pairs stored, the readout error at any key exceeds the sum of the absolute values of the other stored values.

toy_example.description: Stores three pairs, then reads each key back and reports the state norm.
